d: Cristiano Ronaldo's 30-day suspension following his Portugal camp walkout during UEFA Nations League has left a lot of people questioning both the punishment and the timing of it. Yes, there's a ban and a 285 USD fine, but because the suspension was backdated, the Portugal captain isn't actually expected to miss a single match. Ronaldo has since apologised and accepted the consequences, but it still puts the Portuguese Football Federation in an awkward spot. Rupha Ramani looks at Portugal's disciplinary decision, the reasoning behind it, and the tricky challenge of balancing accountability…
